name: friction coefficient
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 表征接触界面摩擦力与法向力关系的系数。
usage_overview: 在轨枕—道砟相互作用的离散元分析中，作为控制接触摩擦作用的参数，用于考察骨料摩擦对轨枕横向阻力的影响。

complete_examples.text: The same trend is evident across different friction coefficient conditions.
Additionally, the results indicate that increasing the friction coefficient at the bottom of the sleeper can effectively enhance the lateral resistance.
